description: Rank partners of one reporter by trade value for a single annual EBOPS series. Omit service_code for total services, or use comtrade_list_service_categories to find one category. EB serves original reports, while EB10 and EB02 serve converted series. Shares divide by the sum of eligible retrieved partners before the display limit. Read coverageNotice before interpreting the ranking.

classification.description: EB for as-reported data (default), or EB10 or EB02 for UN Comtrade’s converted series.

limit.description: Number of partners to display. Counts and sums precede the display limit.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting area (0–999).

service_code.description: One EBOPS service code. Omit or pass blank for total services.

name: comtrade_get_top_services_partners

classificationCode.description: Actual scheme of the selected series.

coverageNotice.description: Scope of the retrieved data and conditions that prevent ranking.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns malformed services data. `rate_limited`: UN Comtrade rate-limits the ranking request through its retries. `upstream_unavailable`: The ranking request hits an upstream server or network failure through its retries. `deadline_exceeded`: The ranking request does not complete within its time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

isOriginalClassification.description: True for an original series, false for a UN Comtrade conversion, when established.

notice.description: Next steps when no services series is selected.

partners.description: Retrieved partners, ordered by descending value when available.

items.description: One partner in the selected services series.

rank.description: Rank when the retrieved series can be ranked.

sharePercent.description: Percentage of the eligible retrieved partner value.

reporterCode.description: M49 code of the reporting area.

serviceCode.description: Selected service category or scheme total code.

totalPartners.description: Eligible retrieved partners before the display limit.

totalValueUsd.description: Sum of eligible retrieved partner values before the limit, when all are known.

truncated.description: True when the upstream retrieval was capped or incomplete.

title: Get Top Services Trading Partners
